subject: Azure offer sandbox bootstrapping & co-sell intake
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace-team@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Azure offer sandbox bootstrapping & co-sell intake

Hi team,

We are ready to move CloudSolve's SaaS offer into the Azure sandbox and kick off the co-sell intake. A few asks and constraints on our side:

- Publisher account: CloudSolve has granted us invited admin access (screenshot attached) but their publisher contact is out until next week. Can you provision a sandbox publisher tenant scoped to their publisher ID so we can validate the offer manifest and test SSO flows?
- Technical validation: we'd like to run a quick automated manifest check and a manual deployment test in the West US region. Please confirm any required SKU mappings for SaaS (metered usage) offers.
- Co-sell intake: CloudSolve expects co-sell enablement within two weeks. Please advise the co-sell questionnaire timeframe and any required 3rd-party attestations.

Attached: publisher-invite-screenshot.png, offer-manifest-draft.json, co-sell-intake-form.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) Microsoft provisions sandbox publisher or confirms invite flow by EOD tomorrow.
2) Redwood runs manifest check and shares any blockers.
3) Schedule 30-minute validation call (internal + MSFT + CloudSolve) if there are infra/identity questions.

Would appreciate a short reply with the provisioning ETA and any portal links.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cope@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

From: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace-team@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudSolve Onboarding <onboarding@cloudsolve.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Azure offer sandbox bootstrapping & co-sell intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear ask — happy to help. Quick answers and actions we just kicked off:

1) Publisher sandbox provisioning: We can create a tenant-scoped sandbox for publisher ID CS-88-991. We need the publisher's MPN ID and a confirmation that CloudSolve approves Redwood admin access (email from the publisher). Once we have that, we'll provision within 48 business hours.

2) Automated manifest check: Please upload the manifest JSON to the Azure publisher portal link below. We'll run the manifest linter and surface any required schema changes (most common: identity resource paths and plan metadata).

3) Co-sell intake timeline: Once the offer passes validation and a paid plan is configured, internal co-sell enablement is typically 5-10 business days. If CloudSolve has partner center partner status and MPN is active, that shortens the intake. We can start the co-sell questionnaire now; see attached "co-sell-process-guide.pdf" (also copied into the portal).

Portal link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/PublisherHomeBlade
Required fields: MPN ID, legal entity proof (PDF), sample billing records if metered SKU.

Action items for you (Marissa):
- Confirm CloudSolve's MPN ID and re-send publisher approval email to marketplace-team@microsoft.com
- Upload the manifest to the portal and tag it with deal id CS-2025-AZ-17

I'll follow up once the sandbox is provisioned. If you want to accelerate, we can schedule a 20-minute session tomorrow at 10:00 PT to walk through the portal.

Regards,
Priyanka Rao
Azure Marketplace Onboarding
marketplace-team@microsoft.com

[Attachment: co-sell-process-guide.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace-team@microsoft.com>, CloudSolve Onboarding <onboarding@cloudsolve.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Azure offer sandbox bootstrapping & co-sell intake

Looping internal folks to action the manifest and collect MPN/legal docs.

Karthik / Soojin: can you take the validators below? Priority checklist:
- Karthik: run an internal manifest lint and share quick fixes (I attached the draft manifest). Verify identity claims and SSO redirect URIs for the SaaS plan.
- Soojin: gather CloudSolve's MPN ID and legal entity proof PDF; push to the Azure portal.
- Neha: brief on co-sell prerequisites — do we need any additional attestations from CloudSolve for high-risk verticals (finance/health)?

If possible, get back with an update by EOD tomorrow. If the publisher is short-staffed we may need to accept their delegated invite to proceed.

Thanks — I'll take the portal meeting if Azure offers the 10:00 PT slot.

-Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure offer sandbox bootstrapping & co-sell intake

Quick status update — ran the manifest lint against our internal validator and Azure sample rules. Findings:

- Plan metadata: missing "billingDimensions" block for the metered SKU. I'll add a minimal template and attach as a gist link.
- SSO redirect URIs: CloudSolve uses a dynamic redirect pattern; Azure requires explicit hostnames. We need CloudSolve to provide the FQDNs (not wildcard).
- Identity claims: the manifest references an AAD app id that isn't present in the draft. We'll generate a new AAD app registration in the sandbox and share the client id.

I've uploaded the corrected manifest to our shared drive (see link below) and left inline comments where Azure is likely to error. Soojin — once you have the MPN PDF I'll push the manifest to the portal and tag the deal.

If Azure confirms sandbox provisioning tomorrow morning I can join the 10:00 PT call to walk through the portal validation and show the failing lines.

Links: https://shared-drive.redwood.com/CloudSolve/azure-offer-manifest-v1

-Karthik
Lead Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: offer-manifest-v1-updated.json (stub)]
